findings.explanation: HOL4 requires that for ALL v ty, type_ok tysig ty implies σ(v,ty) <: typesem δ τ ty. Lean only requires that SOME v, ty satisfy this implication. Any ty with type_ok false is a witness, so for every tysig that rejects some type (always, since tysig is finite) the Lean predicate is trivially true. Example: mem = (λx y. F), tysig = FEMPTY, any δ τ σ: the HOL4 predicate is false (take ty = Tyvar s), the Lean one is true (take ty = Tyapp s []). is_valuation0 and is_structure0 become too weak, and satisfies0 (hence models0 and entails0) quantifies over ill-typed term valuations.
findings.lean_check:
import CandleLean.HolSemantics

namespace Candle

open HOL Classical

theorem chk_F1 :
    is_term_valuation0 (U := Nat) (fun _ _ => False) FEMPTY (fun _ _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) ∧
    ¬ (∀ (_v : mlstring) (ty : type), type_ok FEMPTY ty → False) := by
  constructor
  · refine ⟨default, Tyapp default [], ?_⟩
    intro h
    rw [type_ok] at h
    have e : FLOOKUP (FEMPTY : fmap mlstring Nat) default = none := by
      unfold FLOOKUP
      exact if_neg (fun hx => hx rfl)
    cases (h.1.symm.trans e)
  · intro H
    exact H default (Tyvar default) (by simp [type_ok])

end Candle
